title: Panna Cotta with Berries
author: Claude
description: Set vanilla cream with a wobble, served with fresh berries.
steps: Soak the gelatin in cold water for 10 minutes.
Warm the cream with the sugar and vanilla until steaming; do not boil.
Off the heat, squeeze the gelatin and stir it in until dissolved.
Pour into 4 glasses and chill for at least 4 hours. Serve with the berries.
